ios.desc:
Adds a Dark theme for Hacker News (news.ycombinator.com). Dark Mode can be configured to be always on or to match the operating system's dark/light theme.

This Safari extension only runs on the Hacker News site. It will not collect or transmit ANY of your browsing activity.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Hacker New Dark Mode Extension for iOS/macOS

quotes.text: I added a Dark Mode style for Hacker News that you can use on your iPhone or Mac. It's free. I hope your eyes appreciate the softer colors while you read the headlines in bed in the morning!
